title: Surreal Cinema Ruins
description: A woman in a glowing white gown sits in a worn purple theater seat on a crumbling balcony, holding a film strip and ticket while watching a projected scene of a glowing sinkhole with figures. The dilapidated building features movie posters, film reels, and the text 'FOLLOW-ALONG' displayed above in the twilight sky.
prompt: A woman in a white gown sits in an old purple theater chair on a decaying balcony overlooking a massive glowing sinkhole filled with silhouettes and purple energy. She holds a film strip and golden ticket. The ruined building walls are covered in old movie posters and film reels. A giant film projector floats nearby casting light. Dramatic twilight sky with purple and orange clouds, text 'FOLLOW-ALONG' visible in the sky, surreal cinematic atmosphere.
